text:
I turned Grok Bot into my own LinkedIn Outbound SNIPER

What it does:-

- Browses LinkedIn as you

- You pick the targets: followers, or everyone engaging with a post (yours or a competitor)

- We find and verify their work emails

- Grok Bot writes each email individually, shows you, then sends from your own Gmail or Outlook

- Capped per day, never emails the same person twice

No mailboxes to buy, no warmup, no dashboard. Only the names leave your Grok Bot.

$29.99/month for 200 verified contacts. Limited numbers to start.

1) Visit https://www.mailagency.ai/
2) Install the template
3) Sign-in
4) Tell it who to reach

Demo video on the site!
